about: Evolution for the Godot version (docs/proposals/creature-catalogue-and-evolution.md section 2; DD-5; EVO-1). New forms and the ways creatures change, beyond the browser game's single level evolutions. Merged into the game data at start: species are added, and evos replace a species' old single evolution. Each evo: to, and at (the level; always required), and any of bond (an added trust step: 1 Friendly, 2 Loyal, 3 Devoted, 4 Bonded), place (a map), with (a species in your team), time, weather, ate, raised (care or battle) and raised_at (that record's trust step). Trust is added to the level. It does not replace it. The first matching option wins, so put special ones first and the ordinary one last. hint is what Maren thinks; the field book shows the first hint once you've seen the creature. bond_branch is the shape for CAT-2's future creature, not a creature you can meet yet. Starter lines are three stages and are never met in the wild. Ripplet becomes Riverwisp at level 16, then Tidewyrm at level 36 with Devoted trust. Cindercub becomes Smoulderpup, then Blazefang. Mosshog becomes Thicketboar, then Thornback. Deeptide, Pyremane and Elderthorn are retired. metres, on a new middle stage, is its height in metres at 12.35 pixels per metre. Wild lists Godot-only encounters as [species, weight] beside a map, kept off the shared map export.

smoulderpup.name: Smoulderpup
smoulderpup.dex: A lanky young wolf, always too warm to hold. Glowing cracks run down its spine, and it steams when the rain finds it.

riverwisp.name: Riverwisp
riverwisp.dex: Gangly and stretched, half swimming and half walking. Its neck frill hangs floppy, and it has not chosen the bank or the river.

thicketboar.name: Thicketboar
thicketboar.dex: Burly and shaggy, and the garden on its back has not settled. Saplings sprout lopsided, and it sheds twigs as it walks.

mistlynx.name: Mistlynx
mistlynx.dex: A Poolkit that grew up in the cloud of the high pass. It slips through fog without a sound and is gone before you see it move.

sunlynx.name: Sunlynx
sunlynx.dex: A Poolkit that grew up devoted to its tamer. Its coat holds the morning light, and it lies across the doorway at night to keep it in.

dawnchorus.name: Dawnchorus
dawnchorus.dex: A Mistfinch that greeted the dawn. Its song carries the first light.

duskwing.name: Duskwing
duskwing.dex: A Mistfinch that hunts at dusk. It flies without a sound.

rainback.name: Rainback
rainback.dex: A Brineskit raised in the rain. Water beads on its back and never falls.

gorgebelly.name: Gorgebelly
gorgebelly.dex: A Brineskit fed on fish. It grew broad and strong.

creekribbon.name: Creekribbon
creekribbon.dex: A ribbon of dark water in the creeks of Saltmarsh Coast. A pale ring circles its middle, and it practises holding the surface still.

murkcoil.name: Murkcoil
murkcoil.dex: The pale ring has gone dull, and the body has thickened. It coils in the pools of Hollowecho Hills, still learning how to part the water.

gloomtide.name: Gloomtide
gloomtide.dex: The dull ring opened into a crest of still water. It crosses a creek without a splash, and the dark follows only where it allows.

seedmoth.name: Seedmoth
seedmoth.dex: It shelters one seed under a wing and dries it over the warm ash of Emberfall Highlands. The wing is still too small to be a garden.

sootcloak.name: Sootcloak
sootcloak.dex: Ash has crusted the wings it meant to open. It drags them, heavy and lopsided, and it still keeps that one seed warm.

hearthbloom.name: Hearthbloom
hearthbloom.dex: The crust split. Its wings open like a small garden, and the seed it carried is the first flower.

dawnfoal.name: Dawnfoal
dawnfoal.dex: A pale foal of Stillreed Basin that stands in the shallows at first light. One spark sleeps in its mane, and it sets each hoof down as if afraid to lose it.

sunford.name: Sunford
sunford.dex: The spark became a mane of morning. Where it steps through a ford, the water lights, and people follow the bright hooves home.

whisperpup.name: Whisperpup
whisperpup.dex: A small hound of Hollowecho Hills. Its ears are too big for its head, and it turns them until the wind in the stones matches a path.

ridgehowl.name: Ridgehowl
ridgehowl.dex: Those oversized ears caught the ridge wind. Its howl runs ahead of a lost walker and lays the path back under their feet.

charcup.name: Charcup
charcup.dex: A little turtle of Saltmarsh Coast that cups one warm coal in a hollow of its shell. It keeps the coal alive.

kilnback.name: Kilnback
kilnback.dex: The coal became a kiln. Seams of heat glow between the plates of its shell, and cold hands are welcome on its back.

glassharrier.name: Glassharrier
glassharrier.dex: The glass in its feathers has opened into wings that throw the grove light down the path.

granitepaw.name: Granitepaw
granitepaw.dex: The claws it wore down on granite have become paws that hold a slope in place.

nightloom.name: Nightloom
nightloom.dex: The webs that used to vanish by morning now hang as a cloak of lasting dusk.

stillmaw.name: Stillmaw
stillmaw.dex: The long wait in the water has become a pool that stays quiet around it.

coalheart.name: Coalheart
coalheart.dex: The faint night glow has settled into a coal that keeps the rocks warm until dawn.

nightcackle.name: Nightcackle
nightcackle.dex: The laugh that used to startle travelers now rolls the dark back from the path.

galecharger.name: Galecharger
galecharger.dex: The foal born to race has become a horse that runs as the wind itself.

willowback.name: Willowback
willowback.dex: The seedlings in its back have taken root, and the bank holds where it rests.

dunemantle.name: Dunemantle
dunemantle.dex: The sand it used to spring from now rides its shoulders like a mantle.

marshcrown.name: Marshcrown
marshcrown.dex: The trails it combed have grown into a crown of living reed.

driftjaw.name: Driftjaw
driftjaw.dex: The pebble jaws that cracked shells now break the driftwood open for everyone smaller.

stormkite.name: Stormkite
stormkite.dex: It still rides the breeze without flapping, and the storm answers its whistle.

spraymane.name: Spraymane
spraymane.dex: The ribbons of spray have become a mane that the shoreline follows.

dewmantle.name: Dewmantle
dewmantle.dex: The morning webs have become a mantle, and the shore drinks before the sun takes it.

ashstride.name: Ashstride
ashstride.dex: The tiny tail prints have become a warm trail the highland rocks remember.

cragbridge.name: Cragbridge
cragbridge.dex: The webs that bridged one crack now hold a path across the crag.

ventmane.name: Ventmane

thermglide.name: Thermglide

screehowl.name: Screehowl

fogslip.name: Fogslip

raylet.name: Raylet

emberdrake.name: Emberdrake

poolkit.hint: Once it trusts you a little and has grown, the cloud of the pass turns it quiet.

Once it trusts you a little and has grown, a diet of fish makes it broad and strong.
Once it trusts you a little and has grown, most of them become the shelter they used to borrow.

bond_branch.about: CAT-2 will name this creature and point these options at it. Not placed, and not a species yet. Every option asks for a level. care is trust from feeding, a festival or a letter; battle is trust from fights together. The same five steps as bond. Trust and how it was raised are added to that level. They do not replace it. First match wins, so the gentle final is listed before the keen one, and the ordinary level change is last. A save with no raised record takes the ordinary option.

options.hint: Cared for until it is Loyal, it grows gentle.
Raised in the fight until it is Loyal, it grows keen.
Left to grow up, it takes the ordinary form.
